actual: Nightly LLM scheduling/advice steps use --invoke-llm with deepseek_api, but several paths still allow fallback_on_llm_error by default. If DeepSeek/GitHub Models invocation fails, artifacts can show deterministic workflow_gate=ready while llm_invoked=false/degraded. This makes the pipeline look healthy even when the intended LLM participation did not happen. Expected: in nightly paths that explicitly require DeepSeek/LLM participation, provider invocation failures must be loud (non-zero) or at least workflow_gate blocked; deterministic fallback remains allowed only for explicit smoke/dry-run paths.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
